_comment: The seven sub-divisions of the Hojaiga system, taken from the layer folders in 'architechure standards-oragn files' (Core Intelligence, Knowledge & Decision, Execution, Platform, Runtime, UI Layer, External). Used to organise ANY ingested repository into the same structural frame. 'signals' are path/identifier keywords the heuristic classifier scores; edit freely, no code change needed.

divisions.name: Core Intelligence
divisions.role: reasoning, planning, orchestration, message routing, state and memory

divisions.name: Knowledge & Decision Layer
divisions.role: what the system knows, the rules it applies, controllers that turn intent into operations, automation of the application

divisions.name: Execution Layer
divisions.role: doing the work safely: permissions, validation, learning from outcomes, files, processes, resources, logging

divisions.name: Platform Layer
divisions.role: agents, plugin and extension surfaces, public APIs, integration with other software

divisions.name: Runtime
divisions.role: the execution substrate: engine loop, model/inference runtime, hardware acceleration, memory management

divisions.name: UI Layer
divisions.role: everything the human touches: windows, panels, menus, toolbars, buttons, dialogs, shortcuts, themes, localisation

divisions.name: External
divisions.role: boundary to the outside world: network, cloud services, file formats, OS and hardware abstraction, third-party software
